abstraction_design.rationale: The shared abstractions (cards, sections, badges, ref-mapping, format helpers) are designed around the app's real variation and stretch well; the gap is the repeated per-resource loader/404/meta boilerplate that a fifth resource must copy.

findings.issue: Sprite URL pattern is duplicated (client urls.ts:9, server pokeapi.server.ts:46 — the server copy is dead, never imported) and reconstructed from card.id instead of using the API's sprites.front_default; a sprite-correctness fix must change the card data shape, both helpers, and the component
findings.suggestion: Carry the sprite URL in PokemonCardData/SpeciesEntry (resolved server-side via mediaUrl) and render it in PokemonCard; delete the dead server spriteUrl and keep one source of truth

findings.issue: Root ErrorBoundary renders 'Not found' for every thrown error (including 5xx ApiErrors from apiGet) and duplicates the NotFound component markup, giving three divergent not-found renderings to maintain
findings.suggestion: Reuse the shared NotFound component in the ErrorBoundary (or better, distinguish error vs 404 via isRouteErrorResponse/error.status)

findings.issue: The decode/lowercase/try-apiGet/isNotFound/data({notFound:true}) loader prologue, its meta guard, and the component's notFound check are copy-pasted across move.tsx, ability.tsx, type.tsx and pokemon.tsx
findings.suggestion: Extract a loadNamedResource(kind, name) helper in pokeapi.server.ts and a shared meta/title helper so a new resource route is a few lines

findings.issue: Damage-relations badge markup inlines the type-badge span and var(--type-*) styling instead of reusing TypeBadge from ui.tsx
findings.suggestion: Use the TypeBadge component so badge styling/markup changes in one place

findings.issue: The em-dash num() display helper is duplicated (move.tsx:41 and inside MovesTable at pokemon.tsx:224)
findings.suggestion: Move it into lib/format.ts next to EM_DASH

findings.issue: API_BASE_URL default and trailing-slash normalization duplicated between root.tsx:7 and pokeapi.server.ts:5; changing the default or normalization rule needs two edits
findings.suggestion: Export a resolveApiBase() from pokeapi.server.ts (or a small shared config module) and use it in the root loader

findings.issue: Loaders are typed as any throughout (pokemon.moves as any[], move as any, etc.), so edits to the API-shaping layer lose type guidance
findings.suggestion: Define minimal interfaces for the API records consumed (Pokemon, Move, Type) in lib and use them with apiGet<T>

summary: A well-layered, idiomatic React Router 8.5.1 framework-mode app: HTTP/caching, formatting, shared UI, and routes each live in one place, so most changes land in a predictable file. The main editability costs are knowledge duplicated across the server/client seam (sprite URL patterns, API base defaults), a copy-pasted loader/404 prologue in all four resource routes, and a root ErrorBoundary that mislabels all errors as 'Not found'. None of these would block a merge; they are cheap refactors the next feature (e.g. Items) would benefit from.
